findings.current: “Young Hero Jin is not wrong. I respect you, Sir Zhuge, but this isn’t right.”
findings.defect: Taekyung’s first-person rhetorical question is changed into a third-person statement about “Young Hero Jin,” altering the speaker-subject relationship.
findings.rationale: 제가 means “I,” and 틀린 말 했습니까 asks whether what Taekyung said was wrong; he does not refer to himself by title in the third person.
findings.replacement: “Am I wrong? I may respect you, Sir Zhuge, but this isn’t right.”
findings.source: 제가 틀린 말 했습니까. 제가 아무리 제갈 대협을 존중한다지만 이건 아니죠.

findings.current:
“……Repeat after me. Amitabha Buddha.”

“Ah, my apologies. Amitabha Buddha.”
findings.defect: The translation conflates 무량수불 with 아미타불, erasing Hyeongong’s correction and the joke created by Taekyung cycling through the wrong religious invocations.
findings.rationale: Taekyung has just said 아미타불, “Amitabha.” Hyeongong deliberately corrects him to the distinct Daoist-style invocation 무량수불, literally “Infinite Life Buddha.”
findings.replacement:
“……Repeat after me. Infinite Life Buddha.”

“Ah, my apologies. Infinite Life Buddha.”

findings.current: Of course, I felt sorry for what had happened to the Dongting Fisherman, but there had been nothing else I could do.
findings.defect: The passive “what had happened” removes Taekyung’s explicit acknowledgment that he personally wrecked the Dongting Fisherman.
findings.rationale: 동정어옹을 작살 낸 건 directly identifies Taekyung’s violent action against the Dongting Fisherman; it is not a vague misfortune that merely happened to him.
findings.replacement: Of course, I felt bad about wrecking the Dongting Fisherman, but there had been nothing else I could do.
findings.source: 물론 동정어옹을 작살 낸 건 미안하게 생각하지만, 나로서는 어쩔 수 없는 일이었다.

findings.current: I had even gone to visit him in the hospital because I felt bad. He had been unconscious, though, so we hadn’t been able to talk.
findings.defect: The draft invents a hospital as the location of the visit. The source only says Taekyung paid the injured man a visit.
findings.rationale: 병문안 denotes visiting someone who is ill or injured but does not establish a modern hospital, which would be an unsupported setting detail in Murim.
findings.replacement: I had even gone to check on him because I felt bad. He had been unconscious, though, so we hadn’t been able to talk.
findings.source: 안 그래도 미안해서 병문안도 다녀왔다. 혼절해 있던 상태라 대화를 나누진 못했지만.

findings.current: And everyone gathered here was made up of physical types who preferred settling negotiations with their bodies rather than with words.
findings.defect: The sentence is grammatically malformed and fails to use the established rendering “physical school” for 육체파.
findings.rationale: The source jokingly categorizes them as 육체파, the established “physical school,” while contrasting verbal bargaining with bodily force.
findings.replacement: And the people gathered here belonged to the physical school, preferring to negotiate with their bodies rather than with words.
findings.source: 하지만 이곳은 현대가 아닌 무림이고, 이 자리에 있는 이들은 말로 하는 흥정보다는 몸으로 나누는 대화를 선호하는 육체파들이었다.

findings.current: As I stared at Perfected Being Hyeongong, whose appearance I had trusted for a brief moment, I realized something once again.
findings.defect: The draft says Taekyung trusted Hyeongong’s physical appearance, producing an unintended and unnatural meaning.
findings.rationale: 잠시나마 믿었던 modifies Hyeongong himself: Taekyung briefly believed in his apparent moral superiority, not in the reliability of his appearance.
findings.replacement: As I stared at Perfected Being Hyeongong, whom I had trusted for one brief moment, I realized something once again.
findings.source: 잠시나마 믿었던 현공진인의 모습을 보며, 나는 다시 한번 깨달았다.

findings.defect: 개평 is a consolation share given to a gambling loser or bystander, not the house’s commission. The current line reverses the joke’s role structure.
findings.rationale: Taekyung frames the reduced allotment to the defeated Zhuge Feng as 개평—a consolation cut—while 국룰 means a universally accepted or unwritten rule.
findings.replacement: “Even the loser gets a cut. That’s the universal rule.”

findings.defect: The second sentence transliterates a Korean internet catchphrase into meaningless English rather than conveying its triumphant jackpot punchline.
findings.rationale: 요시 그란도 시즌 is used as an exuberant victory or big-win meme; “Yoshi, grand season” communicates neither that function nor intelligible English.

findings.defect: The draft generalizes 쟁취하다 into winning, losing the immediate point that the fighter seizes or claims the spoils.
findings.rationale: The line justifies Taekyung’s entitlement in the distribution dispute; 쟁취하다 means to seize or obtain through struggle, not merely to win a contest.
findings.replacement: Those who fight claim the spoils.

summary: One critical speaker-subject error, several meaningful fidelity defects, and localized terminology and prose issues.
